# mods-info

Live information for the multiplayer mods that use the central relay server. **The mods download these
files while they run**, so changing a file here changes what every player's mod does: the server address,
the "update available" message, and notices. A server move is one edit to `servers.json`.

Questions, bugs, or looking for people to play with? Join the [Multiplayer Everything Discord](https://discord.com/invite/P2MSSUf5GX).

## Files
| File | What |
|---|---|
| `servers.json` | the central server(s), shared by every mod |
| `mods/<id>.json` | one file per mod; `<id>` is the mod's relay game id |
| `index.json` | every mod id and its file (generated) |
| `schema.json` | the format of the files above |
| `tools/validate.py` | checks every file and regenerates `index.json` and the table above |

Mods read the files from `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/multiplayereverything/mods-info/main/<file>`.

## Format
`servers.json`: `servers[]` with `id`, `name`, `address` (`host:port` of the relay; empty = not set),
`status` (`online`, `offline`, `maintenance`) and an optional `notice`.

`mods/<id>.json`:
| Key | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `schema` | always `1` |
| `id` | relay game id, same as the file name |
| `name`, `game`, `engine` | display text |
| `status` | `planned`, `in-progress`, `testing` or `released` |
| `latest_version` | newest build (numbers and dots). An older build shows "Update available" |
| `min_version` | oldest build allowed online. Older builds are told to update; LAN and single player still work |
| `protocol` | the version string the mod sends to the relay |
| `download_url`, `changelog_url` | empty or an `https://` link; only ever shown to the player |
| `relay` | `mode` (`star` or `tunnel`), `max_players`, `server` (an id in `servers.json`), optional `address` override |
| `notice` | one line shown in the mod's online menu, or empty |
| `updated` | date of the last change, `YYYY-MM-DD` |

Mods ignore keys they don't know. A new key is added to every mod file at the same time.

## How every mod uses it
1. When it starts or opens its online menu, it downloads `servers.json` and `mods/<id>.json` in the background
   (about 5 s timeout). The game never waits for it.
2. It checks the files with the same rules as `tools/validate.py` and ignores anything invalid.
3. It keeps the last good copy, so it still works offline.
4. Server address, first match wins: the address the player typed in the mod's settings, then the downloaded
   one, then the saved copy, then the address built into the mod.
5. It shows "Update available" and any notice in its online menu.
6. It never downloads or runs anything from these files by itself.

## Adding a mod
Every new multiplayer mod gets a file here, in the same format:
1. Copy an existing `mods/<id>.json` to `mods/<new id>.json` and fill in every key.
2. Run `python tools/validate.py` (it updates `index.json` and the table above).
3. Build the download (steps above) into the mod.

## Rules
This repo is public: no tokens or keys, no game files, no decompiled code, no private addresses or local paths.
Run `python tools/validate.py --check` before every push.
